card.line: Pharpar was a swift river of Damascus. Naaman, a commander with leprosy, named it as a better place to wash than the waters of Israel.

moments.title: Naaman's angry boast
moments.text: Naaman was angry that Elisha did not come out and wave his hand over him. He said the Abanah and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, were better than all the waters of Israel, and he left in a rage.
